title: earthmodel: one distractor that printed the correct easting

items.reason: Distractor 0 printed the correct x 1794.719681048036 (only its stated reasoning was wrong, and 300 m was not even the hold length); it now prints the station TVD, a real column-misread mistake.

0.old: x 1794.719681048036, adding the 300 m hold length as easting.

explanation.old: The 400 m hold contributes 400/sqrt 2 = 282.84 m east. Doubling the build increment or equating x with MD are both real mistakes the numbers punish.
explanation.new: The 400 m hold contributes 400/sqrt 2 = 282.84 m east. Reading the TVD column as easting, doubling the build increment or equating x with MD are all real mistakes the numbers punish.
